run_setup_all_collections: run the script to create and populate all Qdrant collections from the NEW_COLLECTIONS config list
run_process_file: run process_file with a config dict containing file_path and collection_name to index a markdown file into Qdrant
create_markdown_splitter: create chunks from markdown text by splitting on headers with a configurable max chunk size
create_qdrant_client: create a QdrantClient instance using the configured QDRANT_URL and QDRANT_API_KEY
create_embedding_model: create a SentenceTransformer embedding model using the configured all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model
